articles.title: Think twice before installing this device promising free movies
articles.content: In exchange for free stuff, devices make home connections part of a proxy network.
articles.titleZh: 在安装此设备之前，请三思而后行，有望获得免费电影
articles.contentZh: 为了换取免费的东西，设备将家庭连接作为代理网络的一部分。

articles.title: Inside Meta’s push to put robots to work in data centers
articles.content: The company is testing robots on tasks that can performed by technicians.
articles.titleZh: Meta推动机器人在数据中心工作
articles.contentZh: 该公司正在测试机器人可以由技术人员执行的任务。

articles.title: Authorities arrest 2 alleged members of prolific hacking group TeamPCP
articles.content: The group infected more than 1,000 organizations in a relentless supply-chain attack campaign.
articles.titleZh: 当局逮捕了2名涉嫌多产黑客组织TeamPCP的成员
articles.contentZh: 该组织在无情的供应链攻击活动中感染了1000多家组织。

articles.title: Claude, Codex, and Hermes installed unowned code inside corporate networks
articles.content: 227 install commands were found in corporate docs pointing at code nobody owns.
articles.titleZh: Claude、Codex和Hermes在公司网络中安装了无人拥有的代码
articles.contentZh: 在公司文档中找到227个安装命令，指向没有人拥有的代码。

articles.title: The Google TV Streamer now costs $50 more
articles.content: Google raised the price of its 4K streaming box to $149, up $50 from its original $99 price. The new price is currently live at the Google Store and Best Buy, but Amazon appears to still be offering the original price. The price hike comes just a couple of weeks after Google launched its new […]
articles.contentZh: 谷歌将其4K流媒体盒的价格提高到$ 149 ，从原来的$ 99价格上涨了$ 50。新价格目前在谷歌商店和百思买上线，但亚马逊似乎仍在提供原价。价格上涨发生在谷歌推出新[…]的几周后。

articles.title: JMGO’s very bright all-in-one projector looks ideal for gamers and sports
articles.content: JMGO's 4K 120Hz Iris Ultra Max all-in-one Google TV projector is now available outside China. It gets its name from a new dual-iris system that lets it produce an impressive 10,000:1 native contrast, according to JMGO. It boosts the contrast - always an issue with projectors - by placing two separate physical apertures (irises) along […]
articles.titleZh: JMGO非常明亮的多合一投影仪看起来非常适合游戏玩家和运动
articles.contentZh: JMGO的4K 120Hz Iris Ultra Max多功能一体Google TV投影仪现已在中国境外上市。根据JMGO的说法，它的名字来自一个新的双IRIS系统，它可以产生令人印象深刻的10,000 ： 1的原生对比度。它通过沿[…]放置两个独立的物理孔径（虹膜）来增强对比度（投影仪始终存在问题）。
